author: Hoon Kim
title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content:
**Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator**
We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds.
Quality level matching the attached characters
Requirements:
- Japanese anime art style (see attached images)
- Experience with 2D game character art
- Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors)
To apply: Send your portfolio.
Feel free to reach out!

author: Nellyslife
title: HIRING: Freelance Illustrator & Graphic Designer (Philippines)
content:
HIRING: Freelance Illustrator & Graphic Designer (Philippines )
Remote · Project-based · Start ASAP
Apply by email only: team.nellyslife@gmail.com
Send your portfolio, rates and availability, with the subject line “Freelance Illustrator / Designer – [Your Name]”.
DMs and comments won’t be considered
Please read the requirements in the graph below BEFORE applying to this job
Starting at Php 35,000 for the first month, with the potential to increase to Php 45,000 for future contracts based on performance and design quality. Create high-quality small designs per week based on provided concept statements.
